pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Mirage Cloud Silk is a delicate spiritual plant resembling strands of colored mist. Its fine fibers sway with the mountain winds, creating an almost illusory appearance. It favors open highlands, where clear air and drifting clouds meet.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Meadows, cherry groves, windswept hills, and jagged, frozen, or stony peaks.
